all of us went or are still going through the partner visa process. you can read more here about it, we also have an article about if you need a lawyer or not: https://aic.org.il/partner-visa-in-israel-step-by-step-guide-to-your-first-visa/ and https://aic.org.il/do-i-need-a-lawyer-to-successfully-get-a-partner-visa/
just an info: if your wife is korean and lives in the US, she will need the personal documents (criminal record and single status/married status document) from both countries. timeline depends on each case, but also on the city you are living in (and apply).
